recommendation: Do not interpret a transported interior-pair model losing gain at line starts as disappearance of cross-line dependence. A same-population refit plus calibrated detection is necessary before such a claim.

scope.allowed_data: Exactly the four saved train+legacy/dev gz files identified in population.json. Existing method source/protocols and saved prior-art review only.

population_audit.overlapping_exclusion_note: First failing condition, mutually exclusive; one IT dev pair satisfies both unknown and paragraph/block exclusion.
population_audit.physical_adjacency_limit: Main population is adjacent parser physical rows within known paragraph/block, not individually image-certified reading adjacency.
population_audit.source_file_adjacency_limit: max(previous.source_lines)+1 == min(current.source_lines) only means consecutive original file line numbers. Comments or blanks can falsely exclude visually adjacent rows. It is not a physical-layout gold standard.

estimand.variables: Y=first unit of current word; X=last unit of previous word; C=known metadata and role conditions, no target length.
estimand.interpretation: Relative log score of two frozen predictors on the same cross-line targets. With identical continuation/EOS/target-identity costs, complete-word gain equals first-unit gain.
estimand.identity: Delta_transport = I_cross(X;Y|C) + E_C KL(P_cross(Y|C)||Q0) - E_CX KL(P_cross(Y|C,X)||Q1).
estimand.identity_conditions: All distributions use the same normalized outcome space and positive support; expectations are under the chosen cross-line population/weights. Q1 denotes the final fixed mixture, not its uncombined child.
cannot_infer: Zero/negative transfer gain does not show independence.
Positive transfer gain need not establish a conditional-dependence magnitude: it can improve baseline marginal calibration.
A different population loss cannot be directly compared as if it were a paired gain.
Complete-word log-score gain is not plug-in mutual information or evidence of grammar/translation.

distribution_shifts.detail: Existing records() trains source slots 1,3,... and target slots 2,4,..., both excluding true line endpoints. Proposed sources are line-final and targets line-first.

position_bin=0 groups interior early positions; it is not line_first. paragraph_line labels the whole first paragraph row. Eligible same-paragraph cross-line targets necessarily have paragraph_start=false.

Line roles can change first/last units, lengths, unknown rates, context counts, and backoff behavior. Sparse exact H/I/length cells can erase gain even under real dependence. Inspect support without treating it as an outcome test.

The missing/paragraph-known/excluded-locus filters change population composition. Dev has 647 ZL / 656 IT targets but only 41 pages / 17 leaves; H4 has 4 / 5 targets and H5 is absent. ZL and IT are not independent manuscripts.

Original frozen Q uses page H; inline-H sensitivity is a separately frozen model. Pure transport must preserve the exact chosen metadata scope, or label the changed observer. Source/target hand transitions must be explicitly represented or reported.
Parser adjacency and source-file adjacency are distinct; neither has pairwise image certification here. No assumption that physical line order necessarily certifies historical reading order.

minimal_proposed_experiments.name: Frozen predictor transport on same cross-line targets
minimal_proposed_experiments.question: Does the already fixed interior observer improve relative prediction when transported to the eligible cross-line population?
minimal_proposed_experiments.fitting: None. Use the frozen Q0/Q1, alphabet mapping, target-only escape and continuation. Keep original page-H definition, or separately label a wholly specified inline-H observer.
minimal_proposed_experiments.evaluation: If later authorized, use only current saved dev population, all prespecified representations; show paired gains, both absolute losses, fallback/support counts and role marginals. Do not compare unpaired absolute losses between within-line and cross-line populations.
minimal_proposed_experiments.claim_limit: Transfer only; a negative result is not evidence that dependence disappears. This optional stage is unnecessary if it cannot inform the next design.

minimal_proposed_experiments.name: Detection and role-shift calibration
minimal_proposed_experiments.question: Can the planned estimator distinguish equal within/cross dependence from independence at the observed sample sizes and sparse contexts?
minimal_proposed_experiments.design: Generate controlled dependent and independent pairs, with a separately specified line-role marginal shift and fixed cluster/missing masks. Include an equal-dependence-across-regimes case and a weaker predeclared effect; a severe shift should not be mistaken for absence. Select synthetic effect sizes without inspecting manuscript gains.
minimal_proposed_experiments.budget: Same model architecture, fit sizes, smoothing/weight grid and selection procedure as E3, repeated fixed seeds; no tuning to make the manuscript look like controls.
minimal_proposed_experiments.claim_limit: Known-positive synthetic channels establish only scoped detection. Latin prose is an ecological comparison, not a guaranteed positive control. If positive controls fail, retain negative manuscript outcomes as inconclusive.

minimal_proposed_experiments.priority: minimal fair substantive check if calibration succeeds
minimal_proposed_experiments.name: Fit baseline and endpoint feature on the same target regime
minimal_proposed_experiments.question: Does a source endpoint improve new-target prediction after learning line-first marginals from the same cross-line training population?
minimal_proposed_experiments.training: Train+legacy eligible cross-line records only for cross models. Fit Q0 and Q1 on exactly the same target records and known conditions, without target length. A within-line comparison needs its own same-regime Q0/Q1 and identical search budget, not merely transport of an interior model.
minimal_proposed_experiments.selection: Reuse alpha [1,5,20,100,500], mixture [0,.25,.5,.75,1], last-unit feature only. Select using predeclared whole-leaf inner folds within train+legacy, then evaluate saved dev once descriptively. If dev is used instead for tuning, it cannot also be called independent test. Any direct transport uses old frozen parameters and is separate.
minimal_proposed_experiments.normalization: Same complete nonempty word factorization, EOS and finite-unit target-only escape as the existing complete-word model. Shared continuation cancels in gains but all costs remain reported.
minimal_proposed_experiments.fairness: Both candidate and baseline see the same role metadata and target population. Alternative has added feature capacity; equal search budget does not equal equal capacity. Report common support and, if planned in advance, matched-size within-line subsampling; do not choose a favorable matching after scores.
minimal_proposed_experiments.reporting: Prespecify ZL EVA, ZL merged and IT EVA with all outcomes; page then leaf means and descriptive uncertainty. This design specifies no new confirm/reserve scoring use; any later execution needs a separately explicit frozen scheme and does not change the already frozen final-reserve package. Within-versus-cross difference must be estimated directly with cluster-aware uncertainty, not by comparing two significance labels.
minimal_proposed_experiments.claim_limit: At most scoped out-of-sample predictability. A disappearance/equivalence claim needs a predeclared practically meaningful tolerance and demonstrated sensitivity at that tolerance; an interval containing zero is insufficient.

prior_art.relation: The paper uses boundary mutual information, position permutations and line-break checks. Our fixed predictive gain has a different estimand. This proposed work is a predictive follow-up, not an exact numerical replication or a new discovery of boundary phenomena.
prior_art.exact_reproduction_requirements: Before claiming replication, fix the paper version, unit grouping, pair selection, missing/line-break handling, null exchangeability and statistic. Keep that descriptive statistic separate from the new predictive endpoint; a retained-subset result is not a full-book replication.

stopping_advice: No new experiment is needed merely to fill the remaining time. Current evidence supports completing the design record and preserving the final reserve protocol unchanged.

wording_amendment.reason: Clarify scientific design scope rather than imply missing user authorization.
